title: Data Atlas Icons
summary: A high-clarity icon palette that makes datasets, tables, notebooks, scripts, and generated assets easy to distinguish.
details: Data Atlas is optimized for computational and empirical Studies. Data and table formats carry the strongest cues, while code, formal sources, manuscripts, images, configuration, and archives retain a disciplined semantic hierarchy.
features: Strong differentiation between datasets and tabular files
Clear source, image, configuration, and archive categories
Compact symbols for data-heavy Study explorers
